requirements.general_text: Applicants must have one of the following: 5 SPM/SPMV Credits: At least a credit in Mathematics. At least a credit in 2 Science subjects (Biology/Chemistry/Physics). A pass in Bahasa Melayu and History. 5 O-Level Credits: At least a credit in Mathematics. At least a credit in 2 Science subjects (Biology/Chemistry/Physics). 3B’s in UEC: At least a credit in Mathematics. At least a credit in 2 Science subjects (Biology/Chemistry/Physics). Other equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government. Note: Forecast results are accepted. A conditional offer will be given to those who meet the entry requirements.
